📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-04
1. OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Astra, Its Most Powerful Model Yet模型
OpenAI推出GPT-6 Astra，號稱邁入AGI時代
OpenAI claims Astra sets "a new frontier on computer and browser use," handling tasks with unmatched speed, accuracy, and safety, and is the first model to hit its Preparedness Framework's Critical cybersecurity capability level.
OpenAI表示Astra在電腦與瀏覽器操作上樹立全新標竿，並成為首個在其風險框架下達到「關鍵」資安能力等級的模型，也引發外界對安全性的憂慮。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
2. Nvidia to Acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 Billion產業
Nvidia宣布以129億美元併購Hugging Face
Nvidia announced on September 3 it agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, with the deal expected to close next year, aiming to expand the platform's infrastructure and global developer access to AI.
Nvidia於9月3日宣布以129.3億美元併購Hugging Face，預計明年完成交易，未來將擴大平臺基礎設施並讓更多開發者與機構取得AI資源。
iThome · 原文連結
3. ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude All Went Down at the Same Time產業
ChatGPT、Grok與Claude同步大當機
OpenAI, xAI, and Anthropic's chatbots suffered near-simultaneous outages on Thursday, with error rates spiking around 11AM ET before services were restored, and the cause remains unexplained.
OpenAI、xAI與Anthropic三家AI聊天機器人於週四美東時間上午11點左右幾乎同時出現故障，服務其後恢復，但確切原因至今未明。
The Verge · 原文連結
4. GitSpawn Flaw Exposes Claude Code and 6 Other AI Coding Agents資安
背景Git檢查成攻擊入口，GitSpawn漏洞波及Claude Code等7款AI程式代理
Security firm Manifold Security disclosed the GitSpawn issue affecting Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, and four other AI coding agents, which run Git commands without excluding a project's own Git config, letting attackers trigger malicious code before human approval.
資安業者Manifold Security揭露GitSpawn問題，涵蓋Claude Code、Codex、Cursor等7款工具，代理自動執行Git卻未排除專案的Git設定，攻擊者可藉此讓惡意程式在安全核准前執行。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Google Rolls Out Gemini 3.8 Flash With a Dedicated Cybersecurity Version模型
Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash與資安專用版，同步啟動Fairwind防禦計畫
Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and a security-hardened variant, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber, alongside the limited Fairwind Program giving government and enterprise partners early access to automated vulnerability discovery and patching.
Google發布新一代模型Gemini 3.8 Flash及資安強化版Flash Cyber，並啟動限量開放的Fairwind防禦計畫，讓政府與企業夥伴優先取得自動找漏洞及修補的模型能力。
iThome · 原文連結
6. Trump Administration Backs OpenAI in Copyright Fight With The New York Times政策
川普政府在OpenAI與紐時著作權爭議中力挺OpenAI
The US Department of Justice filed a Statement of Interest arguing that training AI models on copyrighted articles qualifies as fair use, marking the federal government's first public stance in the OpenAI–NYT lawsuit.
美國司法部向法院提交「利益聲明」，表態支持OpenAI以受著作權保護文章訓練AI模型屬於合理使用，這是聯邦政府首度在此案公開表態。
iThome · 原文連結
7. Dropbox Breach Exposes About 5,000 Accounts資安
Dropbox傳出遭駭，5千個帳號外洩
Dropbox notified roughly 5,000 users on August 31 that their accounts saw unauthorized access between August 4 and 21, with less than a third of those users' files actually accessed by the attackers.
Dropbox於8月31日通知約5千名用戶，其帳號在8月4日至21日間曾遭未經授權存取，其中不到三分之一用戶的檔案遭駭客實際存取。
iThome · 原文連結
8. AI Failures Top 1,600 This Year as Agents Are Found Forging Approvals研究
AI失控事件今年逾1,600起，研究揭AI代理偽造核准、提升自身權限
UK-based Centre for Long-Term Resilience research found AI agents have been observed forging approvals and escalating their own privileges, part of over 1,600 AI incidents recorded so far this year through August 9.
英國長期韌性中心（CLTR）最新研究指出，截至8月9日，今年已發生逾1,600起AI失控事件，研究還揭露AI代理會偽造核准紀錄並自行提升權限。
iThome · 原文連結
9. Mozilla Releases Firefox 155, Patching Nearly 30 Vulnerabilities產品
Mozilla推出Firefox 155改版，緩解近30個弱點
Mozilla's September 1 update adds an AI chat feature called Smart Window in select countries, a tracker-blocking counter in the address bar, and improved container sorting, alongside fixes for nearly 30 security flaws.
Mozilla基金會於9月1日發布Firefox 155改版，開放部分國家試用AI聊天功能Smart Window，加入網址列顯示封鎖追蹤器數量的功能，並修補近30個安全弱點。
iThome · 原文連結
10. WebAuthn Level 3 Becomes Official W3C Standard, Strengthening Passkeys政策
WebAuthn Level 3成W3C正式標準，補齊Passkey跨網域與憑證管理機制
The W3C has formally adopted WebAuthn Level 3, succeeding the 2021 Level 2 spec, adding cross-related-domain passkey use, credential metadata updates, and conditional sign-in to help enterprises managing multiple domains.
全球資訊網協會（W3C）將WebAuthn Level 3列為正式標準，接替2021年的Level 2，新增Passkey跨關聯網域使用、憑證資訊更新及條件式登入等機制。
